title: how should long acting insuline (Lantus/Levemir/Toujeo) be used in prediction ?
body:
Already the possibility to distinguish between different types of  insulin that was done in #973 helps with reporting for people using pens.
xDrip does also prediction based on insulin and its pharmacodynamics. 

The prediction is not taking [Lantus](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/973#issuecomment-536295457) into account after 6 hours, but median for its effectivnes is 10.8 to >24.0 hours and also it has very stable infusion rate for all the time.

What would be the correct way to take long action insulin into account in predictions ?
